name: com.tencent.bugly.beta.ui.BetaActivity
description: Tencent Bugly Beta opens this Activity for its in-app upgrade dialogs and related update prompts. Before opening it, Bugly re-enables the screen if it was turned off.
disableEffect: Bugly tries to turn this screen back on before showing an update prompt; if it remains disabled, the in-app upgrade dialog cannot open.
